Hi Alex / Priya 

Thanks again for a great discovery call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned before we put the POC plan on paper: 

Scope (what we’ll validate):
- Inference latency and throughput for your standard batch workloads (avg seq len ~512).
- Cost per 1k tokens with our batching / KV-cache settings.
- Integration with your ETL to run nightly embedding/semantic search jobs.
- Security & data handling: ensure VPC connectivity and keys are handled per your policy.

Success criteria (what counts as a win):
1) 95th percentile latency < 250ms for interactive queries at target QPS.
2) End-to-end nightly pipeline completes within your current SLA window (2 hours) with <5% increased cost.
3) Model output meets your evaluation threshold on the 500-case test set (>0.82 NDCG for rerank).

Proposed timeline:
- Week 0 (this week): finalize SOW and mutual action plan.
- Week 1: environment prep and data exchange (sample datasets, test accounts).
- Week 2: run smoke tests + baseline measurements.
- Weeks 3-4: full evaluation, iter tuning, and wrap-up.

Owners / asks:
- From Finlytics: sample data extract (anonymized) + contact for infra (who will help with VPC / firewall rules).
- From Redwood: Marcus will provision the trial environment and Monica will own success metrics and weekly updates.

Attachments: I’ve attached a first-draft SOW and a mutual action plan template for your review.

Can you confirm the owners above and whether the proposed timeline looks good? Happy to schedule a 30-min sync tomorrow if you’d prefer to walk through the plan.

Thanks
